lines.text: Zedekiah became king at twenty-one, did evil in the LORD's sight, and rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem until Zedekiah's eleventh year, and the famine left the people of the land with no food.
The Chaldeans overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho and brought him to the king of Babylon at Damascus.
Nebuzaradan entered Jerusalem in the tenth month, burned the house of the LORD, and the army broke down the walls.
Nebuzaradan brought the captives to the king of Babylon, who struck them down and put them to death.
